thread:
maya: Heads-up — on the latency dashboard for /v1/embedding (deploy=canary) p95 is showing ~60ms but p50 is 85ms... looks inverted? :eyes:
alex: wait that sounds backwards. can you paste the filters and time range?
maya: time=last_30m, group=endpoint, slice=deployment:canary, aggregation=tdigest-merge, smoothing=5m
nora: did you apply the 'include-retries=false' toggle? retries can skew p50 down if retry fast path exists.
maya: no, default view. I just toggled include-retries=false and p50 moved to 45ms, p95 80ms. so the inversion disappeared. weird.
jay: sounds like sample origin mixing — some rows are server-reported vs proxy-reported. the proxy time is lower on warm cache and is tagged differently. dashboard is merging origins when aggregation=tdigest-merge.
maya: is that expected? should the dashboard show a provenance badge if mixed origins? :thinking:
observability-bot: Note: recent rollout (2026-02-15) enabled 'merge-provenance-by-default' for tdigest merges.
alex: short term, we can make the UI surface sample origin and an option to 'split by origin' in the small hover. long term we probably need a provenance filter at query time so aggregates don't mix.
nora: also watch out for smoothing window. smoothing=5m can 'pull' p50 toward more frequent lower values if sample counts differ across buckets.
jay: repro query I ran:
```
SELECT tdigest_percentile(0.5), tdigest_percentile(0.95)
FROM latency_td
WHERE endpoint='/v1/embedding' AND deployment='canary' AND origin IN ('proxy')
TIME_RANGE=now-30m
```
when restricted to origin=proxy the inversion goes away.
maya: ok — I'll file a tiny UX issue to add 'Provenance: mixed samples' callout + quick filter. filing now.

maya: https://ui.internal/issues/INFR-1423 — added screenshots and example queries.
alex: great, thanks. can we also add a short note in the rollout runbook to avoid toggling merge-provenance-by-default? I'll add a PR to docs.
observability-bot: action logged: issue INFR-1423 created by maya
nora: awesome. low-risk fix: expose a 'split by origin' toggle next to the smoothing control. I'll prototype.
jay: and let's add a unit test to the rollup pipeline: ensure tdigest merges with mixed provenance annotate the merged sample_count_breakdown.
maya: thanks all — closing the thread after follow-ups in the issue. :thumbsup:
